item.title: China Completes First Season of Regular Arctic Container Service
item.dc:creator: Malte Humpert
item.description: China has completed the first season of regular weekly container shipping between China and Europe via the Northern Sea Route, with the operator completing all eight sailings planned for 2026 before ending departures slightly earlier than scheduled because of Arctic ice forecasts.

item.title: Qatar Brings Empty LNG Ships Into Gulf in Potential Export Boost
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: Qatar has amassed a fleet of empty liquefied natural gas tankers in the Persian Gulf, a sign that one of the world’s biggest exporters of the fuel may be preparing to boost shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Houthis Attack Aden Airport as Fighting Intensifies in Yemen
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.description: Yemen's Houthis attacked Aden's international airport with ballistic missiles and explosive-laden drones on Wednesday, the country's Transport Ministry said, as fighting between the Iran-aligned group and Saudi-backed government forces intensified.

item.title: South Korean Operator Emerges as New Force in Arctic LNG Shipping
item.dc:creator: Malte Humpert
item.description: New company takes on four Arc4 LNG carriers as Seoul looks to expand Busan’s role in Arctic shipping. A newly established South Korean ship manager is emerging as a potential new player in Arctic LNG shipping, taking control of four ice-class LNG carriers while planning a rapid expansion into the specialized fleet needed to transport gas along Russia’s Northern Sea Route.

item.title: Volare Jumps in Oslo Debut as Wave of Shipping IPOs Builds
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: Volare Shipping Ltd. jumped on its first day of trading in Oslo on Monday after the spin-off arm of Trafigura Group Pte. became the latest in a spree of tanker listings in the Norwegian capital.

item.title: Gulf Oil Flows Rise to Average 81% of Pre-war Rate in September
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.description: Gulf oil flows excluding Iran surged to over 81% of pre-war levels in September, data showed, led by a recovery in Saudi exports despite attacks on the kingdom's oil infrastructure and escalating Iranian attacks on regional shipping, while Iranian exports fell to zero due to a US blockade.

item.title: War in Ukraine Escalates With Drone Strikes on Cargo Ships
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: Attacks on commercial vessels off the Black Sea’s western coast are on the rise, threatening already-choked trade flows in the region while testing NATO’s readiness to react.

item.description: Five seafarers were killed during the rescue of a hijacked ship off Somalia last week, prompting International Maritime Organization Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez to issue yet another statement mourning merchant mariners...

item.title: Drone Sinks Ship Off Bulgaria, as Fears Grow About Hybrid Attacks By Russia
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.description: The crew of a merchant ship was missing on Tuesday after the vessel sank in the Black Sea off NATO member Bulgaria following a drone strike that Prime Minister Rumen Radev described as a gross violation of international law.
